status: validated (機械検証合格 2026-11-05; パイロット承認済みの方針で作成)

segments.t: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke
segments.note: 「Let」は ἡγείσθωσαν（次セグメント、3人称命令法）を先取りする。Ὅσοι … δοῦλοι を「as many as are bondservants under the yoke」とほぐす

segments.t: count their own masters worthy of all honor,
segments.note: 「their」は英語の補い

segments.t: the name of God and the doctrine

segments.note: καταφρονείτωσαν（3人称命令法）を「let them not despise」とほぐす。「them」は英語の補い

segments.t: but rather let them serve them,
segments.note: δουλευέτωσαν（3人称命令法）を「let them serve」とほぐす。「them」は英語の補い

segments.t: those who partake of the benefit
If anyone teaches a different doctrine
segments.note: ἑτεροδιδασκαλεῖ 1語を「teaches a different doctrine」とほぐす

segments.t: and doesn’t consent to sound words,
the words of our Lord Jesus Christ,
and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

segments.note: 主語の「he」は前節の τις を受ける

segments.t: but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles,
segments.note: νοσῶν περὶ ζητήσεις καὶ λογομαχίας を「obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles」とほぐす

segments.t: constant friction of people of corrupt minds
segments.note: διαπαρατριβαὶ διεφθαρμένων ἀνθρώπων τὸν νοῦν を「constant friction of people of corrupt minds」とほぐす

segments.t: who suppose that godliness is a means of gain.

segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Withdraw yourself from such（ἀποτρέπου τοὺς τοιούτους）」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: For we brought nothing into the world,
segments.note: 主語の「we」はギリシャ語動詞 εἰσηνέγκαμεν に含まれる

segments.t: and we certainly can’t carry anything out.
segments.note: ὅτι を「certainly（確かに）」と訳す。主語の「we」は動詞 δυνάμεθα に含まれる

segments.t: we will be content with that.
segments.note: 主語の「we」はギリシャ語動詞 ἀρκεσθησόμεθα に含まれる

segments.t: But those who are determined to be rich
segments.note: βουλόμενοι πλουτεῖν を「those who are determined to be rich」とほぐす

segments.t: and many foolish and harmful lusts,

segments.note: φιλαργυρία 1語を「the love of money」とほぐす

segments.t: is a root of all kinds of evil.
segments.note: 「kinds」は英語の補い

segments.t: Some have been led astray from the faith

segments.note: ἧς ὀρεγόμενοι（それを切望して）を「in their greed」とほぐす

segments.t: and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

segments.note: 「and」は英語の補い

segments.t: Fight the good fight of faith.
segments.note: ἀγωνίζου τὸν καλὸν ἀγῶνα は同族目的語（the good fight を戦う）

segments.t: Take hold of the eternal life

segments.note: 主語の「you」はギリシャ語動詞 ἐκλήθης に含まれる

segments.t: and you confessed the good confession
segments.note: 主語の「you」はギリシャ語動詞 ὡμολόγησας に含まれる

segments.t: in the sight of many witnesses.
segments.note: ἐνώπιον を「in the sight of」と訳す
主語の「I」はギリシャ語動詞 παραγγέλλω に含まれる

segments.t: who gives life to all things,

segments.note: 「before」は ἐνώπιον の繰り返し

segments.t: who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

segments.note: 「that」は παραγγέλλω の内容を導く英語の補い

segments.t: until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

segments.note: καιροῖς ἰδίοις（定められた時）を「at the right time」と訳す
主語の「he」は神を受ける

segments.t: who is the blessed and only Ruler,

segments.note: τῶν βασιλευόντων（王として治める者たち）を「kings」と訳す
τῶν κυριευόντων（主である者たち）を「lords」と訳す

segments.t: to whom be honor and eternal power.
segments.note: 繋辞の「be」は英語の補い

segments.t: Charge those who are rich in this present age

segments.note: μὴ ὑψηλοφρονεῖν を「that they not be arrogant」とほぐす

segments.t: nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches,
segments.note: ἠλπικέναι を「have their hope set」とほぐす
WEB はビザンティン本文に従い ζῶντι（生きる）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

segments.note: 「that they」は παράγγελλε の内容を表す英語の補い

segments.t: that they be rich in good works,
segments.note: 「that they be」は英語の補い

segments.t: that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
segments.note: εὐμεταδότους を「ready to distribute」、κοινωνικούς を「willing to share」とほぐす

segments.t: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation
segments.note: ἀποθησαυρίζοντας … θεμέλιον καλὸν を「laying up in store for themselves a good foundation」とほぐす
主語の「they」はギリシャ語動詞 ἐπιλάβωνται に含まれる
τῆς ὄντως ζωῆς（本当のいのち）を「eternal life」と訳す
Ὦ（おお）は英語では省略される

segments.t: guard that which is committed to you,
segments.note: τὴν παραθήκην を「that which is committed to you」とほぐす

segments.t: turning away from the empty chatter
and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,
and thus have wandered from the faith.
segments.note: περὶ τὴν πίστιν ἠστόχησαν（信仰から外れた）を「have wandered from the faith」とほぐす
繋辞の「be」は英語の補い
WEB はビザンティン本文に従い ἀμήν を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない
